title: The final ending screen states two directly contradictory outcomes for the same bargain back to back: 'Reedholm never paid the water's tithe. The Priory doesn't say aloud what it thinks that silence is costing them.' immediately followed by 'Reedholm pays its yearly tithe without complaint. The singing is quieter, not gone, and nobody minds much either way.' I explicitly refused the tithe ('tell Halm the water can whistle for it'), so only the first line should appear.
where: final status screen / *** WIN ending, 'How the realm remembers you'
